event-editor.description: Dialog-hosted event form with recurrence editor and scoped delete. The default way to create and edit events.

examples.note: Open the editor through the dialog service. Save emits an immutable draft; delete emits a scope request resolved with resolveSolarisEventDelete; the consumer array is never mutated.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone event editor component.

locales.note: Title, dates, recurrence, and delete scope follow the selected locale.

props.note: Pass the source event (never mutated), the edited occurrence, time zone, and locale. Outputs are eventSave, eventDelete(scope), and eventCancel.

event-editor.title: Event Editor
